title: Quick check: Destructuring Props

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Destructuring Props”?
options: The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Parameter destructuring is best handled through explicit, read-only inputs and clear component composition.
questions.answer_key: Parameter destructuring is best handled through explicit, read-only inputs and clear component composition.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Destructuring Props: Parameter destructuring is best handled through explicit, read-only inputs and clear component composition.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Parameter destructuring?
options: Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Keep props immutable and move shared state to the nearest common owner.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
questions.answer_key: Keep props immutable and move shared state to the nearest common owner.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Destructuring Props: Keep props immutable and move shared state to the nearest common owner.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Destructuring Props” complete?
options: Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Destructuring Props: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
